name: Elders Limited
summary: Elders Limited engages in the provision of agricultural products and services to rural and regional customers primarily in Australia. It operates through Elders Crop Protection, Australian Independent Rural Retailers, Elders Rural Services, Delta Agribusiness, and Elders Real Estate segments. The company engages in the sourcing, regulatory research and development, blending, and formulation of agricultural chemical products for distribution through ERS, Delta Ag, AIRR, and select third-party clients, as well as the provision of retail products and related services to the rural sector.
